full_text: My wife and kids strike again with chalk art. COVID-19 may slow us, but won’t stop us! 💪 We’ll be cheering on the runners in September at Mile 10. 🤘 #WeAreMightyMA #bostonmarathon #mile10 #natick @ Natick, Massachusetts https://t.co/2osvDSj6P2

location_description: Natick ( NAY-tik) is a town in Middlesex County, Massachusetts, United States. It is near the center of the MetroWest region of Massachusetts, with a population of 37,006 at the 2020 census. 10 miles (16 km) west of Boston, Natick is part of the Greater Boston area.
